about_the_game:
"Your next case, Mr Investigator. That's what she calls you.

It's business as usual, another misfortune filed at our doorstep. The only difference this time is our client is very particular about this job and left a note for you to read.

If you want my advice, just do what you do.

Mr Investigator."

_____________________

Detective Work With The Past

Mr Investigator is a first-person murder investigation based on evidence analysis and logical deduction.

Explore the timeline before their death.

Investigate the days prior to the killing. Use your detective intuition to piece together the truth behind the murder.

Gain insight with each question asked.

Cross examine evidence and clues inside the simulated memories. Restore the remaining pages of her father's diary.

content_descriptors.notes: This game demo explores themes of significant personal loss and intense grief that some may find distressing.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (version 1909 or higher) or Windows 11.
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 or 12 compatible with at least 4GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
